gameplay.extra-supplies-one-additional-f: Extra supplies: one additional flash per stage

gameplay.the-alarm-exposed-you-its-foots: The alarm exposed you · Its footsteps quicken!
guide.1: WASD / arrows to move. Shift to sprint. E to interact. After exhaustion, recover 30% stamina before sprinting again.
guide.2: F repels with a flash. R drops a decoy. Q heals 40 health. You can also click item icons. Matching keys are consumed on first unlock. Flashes do not affect the Listener. Use a decoy.
guide.3: T toggles the flashlight. A full charge lasts 120 seconds outside the tutorial. Switching off or hiding stops battery drain.
guide.4: Searching raises danger. The final fuse starts an 8-second power sequence. Keep moving. Use F to stop the crying patient’s lunge.
guide.5: Cross-marked cabinets contain supplies. Tall lockers hide you for up to 8 seconds. Break line of sight before hiding.
guide.title: LEAVE ALIVE.
key.blueObtained: Brass key consumed; blue sealed-box key obtained.
lesson.approach-a-box-and-press-e-to: Approach a box and press E to search. After taking the fuse, prepare for whatever the noise attracts.
lesson.approach-the-brass-key-on-the-flo: Approach the brass key on the floor and press E. Special keys fit matching locks and are consumed on first use.
lesson.it-is-within-flash-range-press-f: It is within flash range. Press F or click the flash device to repel and stun it, then leave.
lesson.press-q-or-click-the-bandage-to: Press Q or click the bandage to restore 40 health. Check that health has recovered to finish the lesson.

settings.title: DUTY NOTES
tutorial.exitText: All three fuses are collected. This green-lit door is your exit. The {seconds, number}-second power countdown resumes when the camera returns. Keep moving, then come here and press E to escape.
tutorial.flashlightText: The upper-right flashlight shows battery charge and time, separately from health. Press T or click its icon. Try switching off, then on. Switching off or hiding stops battery drain; use the beam to see ahead.
tutorial.healthText: The white bar at the upper left is your health. Hits shorten it; at zero, you die. Blinking after a hit gives brief protection. Press Q to heal 40 health with a bandage.
tutorial.monster-light-shyText: Catch it in your beam to make it recoil. Turn away and run: it cowers for about 2 more seconds. It lowers its arms before chasing again. Repeated light hits cannot extend this window during cooldown. Press F for a longer escape window. It ignores decoys while it can see you.
tutorial.monster-light-shyTitle: Light-Shy · Flash your beam, then run
tutorial.monster-listenerText: It is blind, but hears nearby footsteps. Running and searches carry farther. Gain distance or use R to distract it. Flashes do not affect the Listener. Use a decoy.
tutorial.monster-patrollerText: It pursues you on sight. Turn a corner and press E to close a door behind you. Break line of sight before hiding. Flashes stun it for only {seconds, number} seconds. It checks a nearby decoy briefly, then returns.
tutorial.monster-patrollerTitle: Patroller · Turn a corner and close the door
tutorial.monster-weeperText: Press T to turn off your light. Walk quietly and keep your distance. Nearby light, sprinting and noise provoke it. Once it stands, it hunts until it kills you or a flash stops it. Missing, darkness and hiding will not end the hunt. Press F to stop it; dodging only avoids one lunge.
tutorial.monster-weeperTitle: Crying Patient · Do not disturb it
ui.f-repels-nearby-monsters-r-drops-a: F repels nearby monsters. R drops a decoy; move away afterwards. Q heals 40 health. Item icons can also be clicked. Keys unlock matching doors or boxes and are consumed on first use. Flashes do not affect the Listener. Use a decoy.
ui.from-stage-carry-one-flash-decoy-and: From stage 2, carry one flash, decoy and bandage; supply stages add one flash. Press E at a cross-marked cabinet for supplies, or at a tall locker to hide for up to 8 seconds. Break line of sight first. Ordinary furniture is only scenery and cover.
ui.searching-raises-danger-the-final-fus: Searching raises danger. The final fuse starts an 8-second power sequence; keep moving until escape is possible. Distance loses the Listener. Light repels the Light-Shy. Walls, furniture and closed doors block monsters.
ui.t-or-the-battery-icon-toggles-the: T or the battery icon toggles the flashlight. A full charge lasts 120 seconds outside the tutorial. Switching off or hiding stops drain. Use fixed lights to search and your beam to see ahead.
ui.wasd-arrows-to-move-shift-to-sprint: WASD / arrows to move. Shift to sprint. E to pick up, search and operate doors. After exhaustion, recover 30% stamina before sprinting again.
